name: Sofia Vargas
bio:
Sofia Vargas's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. Initially trained as a chef in Bogotá, she relocated to Europe seeking broader culinary experiences. While working at a small restaurant near the Monza circuit, she was offered a temporary position catering for a small racing team. She quickly discovered a passion for the fast-paced, high-pressure environment of motorsport.

Sofia is known for her meticulous planning and ability to create nutritious, delicious meals that cater to the specific dietary needs of drivers and team members. She understands that proper nutrition is crucial for peak performance, and she takes her role very seriously. Her pragmatic approach ensures that resources are used efficiently, and that the team is always well-fed, even under the most demanding circumstances. Her resourcefulness and dedication have made her an invaluable asset to the Iron Dames.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided and pulled back into a practical bun.
physical.description: Sofia is of average height with a warm, inviting smile and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with recipes and ingredient lists.
Insists on sourcing local ingredients whenever possible, regardless of location.
Has a habit of humming traditional Colombian folk songs while preparing meals.
